_comment: DATA-ONLY WATCHLIST (added 2026-09-13). Fetched every night by the same fetch.py in the same eodhd pod — BEFORE the main pass (src/bootstrap.sh) — into data/watchlist/, a subtree nothing downstream reads: build_m1 and validate glob data/*.json non-recursively, stage2 sentiment reads data/news/, load_spy reads data/market/. That isolation is the point: these equities are already live in the m1x trading universe, so filing them under data/ would feed their fundamentals, estimates and news into the next predict. BRK-B is the exception that is ALSO in the main S&P lists (the models keep reading that 2000+ copy); the watchlist copy adds its full history from the 1996-05 listing. To PROMOTE a name into the models, move it into the `stocks` list of tickers.json, sharadar.json and tiingo.json (every fetcher full-fetches a symbol that has no file). Windows start 1990 so each name's whole listed history lands (SPY 1993, TSM 1997, MSTR 1998); eod/dividends/splits re-pull the full window nightly at 1 credit each regardless of length.
_market_comment: ETFs ride the market slots, not `stocks`: a fund has no Earnings::Trend, so `estimates` would append empty snapshots forever. SPY.US duplicates tickers.json's data/market/SPY.US.json on purpose (2 credits a night) so this tree is self-contained and reaches 1993 rather than 2000.
